{

    {
      "chapter_id": 2,
      "title": "The Glass Cannon's Guide to Not Dying",
      "chapter_role": "setup",
      "goal": "Artie needs gear that doesn't rely on him being hit, as he can't take a single blow.",
      "pacing": {
        "expected_scene_count": 11,
        "intensity": 3,
        "tempo": "steady"
      },
      "bridge": {
        "from_prev": "Artie is a marked man in Oakhaven.",
        "to_next": "Artie heads to the Low-Level Crypts to farm 'Evasion' gear."
      },
      "stakes_shift": "Survival shifts from luck to tactical exploitation of the System's bugs.",
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "Shopping for Scraps",
          "intent": "Equip Artie with the bare minimum to survive a dungeon.",
          "end_condition": "Artie is now slightly harder to hit but looks like a neon yellow cat.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "type": "choice",
              "summary": "Artie tries to sell his 'Participation Trophy' to a skeptical pawnbroker but finds out it's soul-bound and cursed.",
              "characters": [
                "CHAR_ARTIE",
                "CHAR_FIZZ",
                "CHAR_PAWNBROKER"
              ],
              "introduces": [
                "CHAR_PAWNBROKER"
              ],
              "threads": [
                "THREAD_SYSTEM_GLITCH"
              ],
              "location_start_label": "Oakhaven Pawn Shop",
              "location_start_id": "LOC_OAKHAVEN_PAWN_SHOP_CBBF48",
              "location_start": "Oakhaven Pawn Shop",
              "location_end_label": "Oakhaven Pawn Shop",
              "location_end_id": "LOC_OAKHAVEN_PAWN_SHOP_CBBF48",
              "location_end": "Oakhaven Pawn Shop",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "outcome": "Artie is stuck with a lighthouse-beacon for monsters.",
              "seam_score": 65,
              "seam_resolution": "micro_scene",
              "transition_in_text": "The bell above the pawn shop door jingles as Artie enters.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "dusty glass counter",
                "cursed artifacts",
                "brass scales",
                "soul-bound tag"
              ],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie leaves the shop, the trophy still glowing brightly in his pack.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "pawn shop door",
                "glowing backpack",
                "bustling street",
                "squinting eyes"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "2:2"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "type": "transition",
              "summary": "Artie navigates the streets of Oakhaven, trying to hide the glowing trophy, until Fizz directs him into a secluded back alley.",
              "characters": [
                "CHAR_ARTIE",
                "CHAR_FIZZ"
              ],
              "threads": [
                "THREAD_SYSTEM_GLITCH"
              ],
              "location_start_label": "Oakhaven Pawn Shop",
              "location_start_id": "LOC_OAKHAVEN_PAWN_SHOP_CBBF48",
              "location_start": "Oakhaven Pawn Shop",
              "location_end_label": "Oakhaven Back Alley",
              "location_end_id": "LOC_OAKHAVEN_BACK_ALLEY_6F3EBA",
              "location_end": "Oakhaven Back Alley",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:1",
              "outcome": "Artie finds a secluded spot to figure out his next move.",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie steps out of the pawn shop, immediately squinting against the glaring light of his own backpack.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "pawn shop door",
                "glowing backpack",
                "bustling street",
                "squinting eyes"
              ],
              "transition_out_text": "He ducks into the damp shadows of the alley, leaning against the brick wall to catch his breath.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "damp brick walls",
                "rusted iron lock",
                "glowing lockpick",
                "gold dust residue"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "2:3"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "type": "reveal",
              "summary": "Fizz points out a loophole in the 'Starter Pack' quest that allows Artie to steal a high-tier cloak if he can crit a lock.",
              "characters": [
                "CHAR_ARTIE",
                "CHAR_FIZZ"
              ],
              "threads": [
                "THREAD_CRIT_EXPLOIT",
                "THREAD_SYSTEM_GLITCH"
              ],
              "location_start_label": "Oakhaven Back Alley",
              "location_start_id": "LOC_OAKHAVEN_BACK_ALLEY_6F3EBA",
              "location_start": "Oakhaven Back Alley",
              "location_end_label": "Oakhaven Back Alley",
              "location_end_id": "LOC_OAKHAVEN_BACK_ALLEY_6F3EBA",
              "location_end": "Oakhaven Back Alley",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "restricted",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:2",
              "outcome": "Artie successfully crits a lock, causing it to explode into gold dust.",
              "seam_score": 15,
              "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge",
              "transition_in_text": "Fizz leads Artie deeper into the shadows behind the general store, pointing at a rusted iron lock.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "damp brick walls",
                "rusted iron lock",
                "glowing lockpick",
                "gold dust residue"
              ],
              "transition_out_text": "The explosion of the lock leaves a single item floating in the air.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "neon yellow fabric",
                "cat-ear hood",
                "shimmering evasion aura",
                "embarrassing tail"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "2:4"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "type": "aftermath",
              "summary": "Artie acquires the 'Cloak of the Cowardly Lion,' which gives +50 Evasion but -100 Dignity.",
              "characters": [
                "CHAR_ARTIE"
              ],
              "threads": [
                "THREAD_CRIT_EXPLOIT"
              ],
              "location_start_label": "Oakhaven Back Alley",
              "location_start_id": "LOC_OAKHAVEN_BACK_ALLEY_6F3EBA",
              "location_start": "Oakhaven Back Alley",
              "location_end_label": "Oakhaven Back Alley",
              "location_end_id": "LOC_OAKHAVEN_BACK_ALLEY_6F3EBA",
              "location_end": "Oakhaven Back Alley",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:3",
              "outcome": "Artie is now slightly harder to hit but looks like a neon yellow cat.",
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie is now slightly harder to hit but looks like a neon yellow cat.",
              "seam_score": 80,
              "seam_resolution": "micro_scene",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie pulls the neon yellow cloak over his shoulders.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "neon yellow fabric",
                "cat-ear hood",
                "shimmering evasion aura",
                "embarrassing tail"
              ],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie heads toward the outskirts of town, avoiding eye contact with everyone.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "neon yellow fabric",
                "town outskirts",
                "confused stares",
                "dirt path"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "2:5"
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "The Crypt of Bad Math",
          "intent": "Test the new gear and the Crit-build in a controlled environment.",
          "end_condition": "Artie discovers he can farm resources much faster than anyone else.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "type": "transition",
              "summary": "Artie sneaks through the outskirts of Oakhaven, his neon yellow cloak drawing confused stares, until he reaches the gloomy entrance of the Low-Level Crypts.",
              "characters": [
                "CHAR_ARTIE"
              ],
              "threads": [
                "THREAD_THE_ASCENSION"
              ],
              "location_start_label": "Oakhaven Back Alley",
              "location_start_id": "LOC_OAKHAVEN_BACK_ALLEY_6F3EBA",
              "location_start": "Oakhaven Back Alley",
              "location_end_label": "Low-Level Crypts Entrance",
              "location_end_id": "LOC_LOW_LEVEL_CRYPTS_ENTRANCE_494A25",
              "location_end": "Low-Level Crypts Entrance",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:4",
              "outcome": "Artie arrives at the crypts, ready to test his new gear.",
              "transition_in_text": "The dirt path leading out of Oakhaven is mercifully empty, though Artie still tugs the neon yellow cloak tighter around himself.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "neon yellow fabric",
                "town outskirts",
                "confused stares",
                "dirt path"
              ],
              "transition_out_text": "The mossy stone steps of the crypt entrance loom ahead, offering a welcome escape from the judging eyes of the townsfolk.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "mossy stone steps",
                "flickering torchlight",
                "rhythmic bone clicking",
                "iron portcullis"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "2:6"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "type": "setup",
              "summary": "Artie enters the Crypts and finds that the skeletons move in predictable, turn-based patterns.",
              "characters": [
                "CHAR_ARTIE",
                "CHAR_FIZZ"
              ],
              "threads": [
                "THREAD_SYSTEM_GLITCH"
              ],
              "location_start_label": "Low-Level Crypts Entrance",
              "location_start_id": "LOC_LOW_LEVEL_CRYPTS_ENTRANCE_494A25",
              "location_start": "Low-Level Crypts Entrance",
              "location_end_label": "Crypts - Hall of Echoes",
              "location_end_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_HALL_OF_ECHOES_601EBE",
              "location_end": "Crypts - Hall of Echoes",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:5",
              "outcome": "Artie begins to treat the world like a rhythm game.",
              "seam_score": 35,
              "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge",
              "transition_in_text": "The air turns cold as Artie descends the mossy stone stairs into the crypt.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "mossy stone steps",
                "flickering torchlight",
                "rhythmic bone clicking",
                "iron portcullis"
              ],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie steps into the first large hall, his cloak glowing in the dark.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "notched bone arrow",
                "stone pillar cover",
                "neon yellow blur",
                "backflip animation"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "2:7"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 7,
              "type": "action",
              "summary": "A Skeleton Archer fires at Artie; the Cloak's evasion procs, causing Artie to do an accidental backflip.",
              "characters": [
                "CHAR_ARTIE"
              ],
              "threads": [
                "THREAD_CRIT_EXPLOIT"
              ],
              "location_start_label": "Crypts - Hall of Echoes",
              "location_start_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_HALL_OF_ECHOES_601EBE",
              "location_start": "Crypts - Hall of Echoes",
              "location_end_label": "Crypts - Treasure Room",
              "location_end_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_TREASURE_ROOM_21F1E8",
              "location_end": "Crypts - Treasure Room",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:6",
              "outcome": "Artie survives his first ranged encounter and gains confidence.",
              "seam_score": 45,
              "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge",
              "transition_in_text": "A skeletal archer notches a notched arrow in the distance.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "notched bone arrow",
                "stone pillar cover",
                "neon yellow blur",
                "backflip animation"
              ],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie moves deeper into the crypt, toward a room filled with treasure chests.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "porcelain pinata shards",
                "floating loot icons",
                "system overload sparks",
                "gold coin fountain"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "2:8"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 8,
              "type": "reveal",
              "summary": "Artie realizes his crits don't just do damage; they cause 'System Overload' effects like turning enemies into loot-filled pinatas.",
              "characters": [
                "CHAR_ARTIE",
                "CHAR_FIZZ"
              ],
              "threads": [
                "THREAD_CRIT_EXPLOIT",
                "THREAD_SYSTEM_GLITCH",
                "THREAD_THE_ASCENSION"
              ],
              "location_start_label": "Crypts - Treasure Room",
              "location_start_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_TREASURE_ROOM_21F1E8",
              "location_start": "Crypts - Treasure Room",
              "location_end_label": "Crypts - Observation Balcony",
              "location_end_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_OBSERVATION_BALCONY_819FB9",
              "location_end": "Crypts - Observation Balcony",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:7",
              "outcome": "Artie discovers he can farm resources much faster than anyone else.",
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie discovers he can farm resources much faster than anyone else.",
              "seam_score": 55,
              "seam_resolution": "micro_scene",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie corners a group of skeletons near a large chest.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "porcelain pinata shards",
                "floating loot icons",
                "system overload sparks",
                "gold coin fountain"
              ],
              "transition_out_text": "Artie hears the sound of heavy boots echoing from the balcony above.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "heavy stone lid",
                "white cape trail",
                "holy light explosion",
                "shattered bone piles"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "2:9"
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
          "title": "The Rival's Shadow",
          "intent": "Reintroduce Vane as a persistent threat.",
          "end_condition": "The boss battle begins with Artie at a massive disadvantage.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 9,
              "type": "escalation",
              "summary": "Vane enters the crypts with a full party, clearing rooms with ease while Artie hides in a sarcophagus.",
              "characters": [
                "CHAR_ARTIE",
                "CHAR_VANE"
              ],
              "threads": [
                "THREAD_VANE_RIVALRY"
              ],
              "location_start_label": "Crypts - Observation Balcony",
              "location_start_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_OBSERVATION_BALCONY_819FB9",
              "location_start": "Crypts - Observation Balcony",
              "location_end_label": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
              "location_end_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_GUARDIAN_CHAMBER_42074B",
              "location_end": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "restricted",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:8",
              "outcome": "Artie sees the gap between a 'proper' build and his own.",

              "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie peers over the edge of a stone sarcophagus.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "heavy stone lid",
                "white cape trail",
                "holy light explosion",
                "shattered bone piles"
              ],
              "transition_out_text": "Vane's party leaves the room, leaving a glowing orb on a pedestal.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "obsidian pedestal",
                "pulsing red orb",
                "boss trigger glyphs",
                "cold stone floor"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "2:10"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 10,
              "type": "choice",
              "summary": "Vane's party leaves behind a 'Boss Trigger'\u2014a rare item that summons a Floor Guardian.",
              "characters": [
                "CHAR_ARTIE",
                "CHAR_FIZZ"
              ],
              "threads": [
                "THREAD_SYSTEM_GLITCH",
                "THREAD_VANE_RIVALRY"
              ],
              "location_start_label": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
              "location_start_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_GUARDIAN_CHAMBER_42074B",
              "location_start": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
              "location_end_label": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
              "location_end_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_GUARDIAN_CHAMBER_42074B",
              "location_end": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:9",
              "outcome": "Artie decides to take the risk and summon the boss for the massive XP.",
              "seam_score": 10,
              "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie approaches the obsidian pedestal with a mix of fear and greed.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "obsidian pedestal",
                "pulsing red orb",
                "boss trigger glyphs",
                "cold stone floor"
              ],
              "transition_out_text": "The red orb shatters, and the floor begins to shake violently.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "massive ribcage",
                "glowing blue eyes",
                "minimum damage readout",
                "bone golem fist"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "2:11"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 11,
              "type": "consequence",
              "summary": "The Floor Guardian, a Bone Golem, emerges, and Artie realizes he forgot to check its 'Minimum Damage' stat.",
              "characters": [
                "CHAR_ARTIE",
                "CHAR_GOLEM"
              ],
              "introduces": [
                "CHAR_GOLEM"
              ],
              "threads": [
                "THREAD_CRIT_EXPLOIT",
                "THREAD_VANE_RIVALRY",
                "THREAD_THE_ASCENSION"
              ],
              "location_start_label": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
              "location_start_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_GUARDIAN_CHAMBER_42074B",
              "location_start": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
              "location_end_label": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
              "location_end_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_GUARDIAN_CHAMBER_42074B",
              "location_end": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:10",
              "outcome": "The boss battle begins with Artie at a massive disadvantage.",
              "end_condition_echo": "The boss battle begins with Artie at a massive disadvantage.",
              "seam_score": 10,
              "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge",
              "transition_in_text": "The Bone Golem fully forms, its massive shadow engulfing Artie.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "massive ribcage",
                "glowing blue eyes",
                "minimum damage readout",
                "bone golem fist"
              ]
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
